patch_description: Revert to the proven RY→RZ→CZ→RZ motif from the prior high-scoring programs (0.72), which achieved perfect accuracy with excellent parameter efficiency. The current program uses parametrized CRZ gates and 20 parameters, scoring only 0.68. Instead, implement the recommendation to split RZ control into "rz_pre" (before CZ chain) and "rz_post" (after CZ chain), providing independent phase control before and after entanglement for fine-tuning interference timing. This reduces parameters from 20 to just 3 (ry_shared, rz_pre, rz_post) while maintaining the high expressivity of the RY→RZ→CZ→RZ structure. The prior single-block variant with 14 params and depth 35 suggests one block is sufficient; using shared parameters across blocks maximizes economy while preserving accuracy.
